question: Under Sarah Mitchell's homeowners policy (policy_HO3_001), what is the maximum dollar amount covered for personal property stolen or damaged while located away from the insured premises?
expected_answer: $140,000 — the full Coverage C limit applies anywhere in the world. The policy contains no off-premises sublimit for general personal property. The only relevant off-premises figure is $1,500 for business property away from the residence premises.
exact_quote: We insure for direct physical loss to personal property owned or used by an Insured anywhere in the world, subject to the Exclusions set forth in this Policy. The limit for Personal Property is One Hundred Forty Thousand Dollars ($140,000).
note: Original ground truth was wrong — cited 10%/$35,000 which is Coverage B (Other Structures), not an off-premises personal property sublimit. No such sublimit exists in this policy.
